finding: The bounded ordinary sparse-material profile accepted only LINE records and refused otherwise eligible CIRCLE and ARC entities, including edits and newly added curves.
change: Share bounded physical-to-delivered identity checks across LINE, CIRCLE and ARC, including records without material references; reject missing delivery, duplicate handles or wrong entity type.

Extend source-field, decoded geometry, default appearance and live-output checks to planar circles and non-reversed arcs. Enforce LibreCAD geometry validity, finite values, supported angle bounds and the existing material graph/staged-output gates.
Retain refusal and destination-preserving retry for unsupported geometry or source data.

validation.focused: macOS ARM64 current installed codec: 10032 assertions across 20 MATERIAL and IMAGE cases pass. The bundled-codec filter translation unit compiles. Cases cover mixed and single-kind sources, linked and unlinked curves, edited and newly added circles/arcs, reopen/resave, a 300-to-20-degree wrapped arc, unsupported thickness/elevation/angles, reverse direction, duplicate identities, suppressed delivery, modified typed or physical geometry, destination preservation and same-filter retry.
validation.peer: ezdxf 1.4.5 independently read three locally generated resaves. It confirmed edited linked circle and arc geometry and material links; the unlinked wrapped arc preserved its 300-to-20-degree bounds; newly added unlinked curves kept their geometry. Each selected LINE, layer, header and ACAD_MATERIAL dictionary named the same material. Audits reported zero errors and fixes.

limits: Only the previously bounded ASCII AC1021 graph and simple planar/default-appearance LINE, CIRCLE and non-reversed ARC profile is admitted. Elevated, thick, nondefault-extrusion, unsupported angle, nondefault appearance and other entity profiles remain guarded.
Generated inputs and independent output readback do not establish native producer semantics, broad DXF/DWG parity, GUI qualification or other platform support. No drawing fixture was committed.
